sources.name: Forecast tiles
sources.notes: The tile service combines several upstream models; each one's terms are in the vendored forecast-tiles register (contracts/forecast-tiles-data-sources.json). Nothing is recorded for the service as a whole. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: ECMWF open data for synoptic charts
sources.notes: Licence copied from LICENCE in analysis/src/deepweather_analysis/ecmwf_open_data.py. The synoptic chart image credit and the GRIB page line say "CC-BY-4.0" and "CC BY 4.0" (analysis/src/deepweather_analysis/synoptic/render.py, engine/src/export/gribDatasets.ts); neither is recorded here as the attribution. Redistribution is not stated. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Copernicus Marine currents
sources.notes: No licence or attribution for this feed is recorded in this repository outside the GRIB page's per-dataset line, which is left as it is. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: ERA5 reanalysis
sources.notes: No licence, attribution or redistribution statement for ERA5 is recorded in this repository. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Météo-France marine bulletins
sources.notes: config/providers.json describes the feed as the official data.gouv BMS mirror, synced daily. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Met Office shipping forecast print page
sources.notes: config/providers.json describes the feed as the shipping-forecast print page, with no API. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: NWS marine alerts (api.weather.gov)
sources.notes: config/providers.json describes the feed as the active-alerts API per marine zone. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Meteoalarm warnings
sources.notes: config/providers.json describes the feed as the Meteoalarm CAP JSON per country. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: BOM marine wind warnings
sources.notes: config/providers.json describes the feed as the marine wind warning summary XML per state over anonymous FTP. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: NOAA CO-OPS tide predictions
sources.notes: Named in analysis/src/deepweather_analysis/tides.py as the official harmonic predictions for US routes. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Maritime Safety Queensland tide predictions
sources.notes: Named in analysis/src/deepweather_analysis/tides.py as official predictions on data.qld.gov.au ("open data" there is a description of the source, not a recorded licence). No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Copernicus Marine sea surface height (tides)
sources.notes: Named in config/providers.json and analysis/src/deepweather_analysis/tides.py as the 15-minute model sea surface height used for tides on some routes. No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: NDBC realtime observations

sources.name: Copernicus In Situ TAC moorings
sources.notes: Named in config/providers.json (near-real-time moorings, Mediterranean). No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Queensland Coastal Data System wave buoys
sources.notes: Named in config/providers.json (waves only). No licence, attribution or redistribution statement is recorded. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: World Port Index (Publication 150)
sources.notes: viewer/src/data/PROVENANCE.md records the licence as public domain (the service item's licence text, "released into Public Domain") and says public domain needs no attribution, so attribution stays null. The copy was obtained on 2026-11-11 from the Esri service, not from NGA; no date is recorded for reading the terms, so verified_on stays null. The file also says Passage does not claim NGA endorsement, and a refresh from NGA is planned. Redistribution is not stated. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap base map tiles
sources.notes: Credit line as rendered, from the attribution in viewer/src/lib/basemap.js (its markup links the OpenStreetMap copyright page). No licence is recorded here. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: OpenSeaMap seamark tiles
sources.notes: Credit line from the seamark layer attribution in viewer/src/components/RouteMap.jsx, viewer/src/pages/planner/PlannerMap.jsx and viewer/src/pages/grib/GribMap.jsx. No licence is recorded here. Terms not yet confirmed.
